label: 第二條件句 If I had..., I would...
prompt: If I ______ more time, I would learn another language.
explanation: 與現在事實相反的假設用第二條件句：If + 過去式，主句用 would + 原形。If I had more time 表示現在時間不夠。
example: If I had more money, I would travel around the world.

label: 倒裝句 Hardly had I entered...
prompt: Hardly ______ the room when the phone rang.
explanation: 否定副詞 Hardly 放在句首時要倒裝：Hardly + had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + when...，意思是「一…就…」。
example: Hardly had the lecture begun when the fire alarm went off.

label: the number of + 單數動詞
prompt: The number of international students ______ increased dramatically.
explanation: the number of（…的數量）後面接複數名詞，但動詞用單數。a number of（許多）才接複數動詞。
example: The number of cars on the road has doubled since 2000.

label: If I were...
prompt: If she ______ taller, she would join the basketball team.
explanation: 第二條件句的 be 動詞常用 were，不分人稱，例如 If I were you。這裡是假設現在身高不夠。
example: If I were you, I would apologise today.

label: would + 原形
prompt: If I lived closer to the office, I ______ walk to work.
explanation: 第二條件句的主句用 would、could 或 might + 原形，不用 will。
example: If I lived nearer, I would cycle to work.

label: If + had + 過去分詞
prompt: If they ______ earlier, they would have caught the train.
explanation: 第三條件句談過去沒有發生的事：If + had + 過去分詞，主句用 would have + 過去分詞。
example: If I had revised more, I would have felt calmer.

label: would have + 過去分詞
prompt: If I had seen you, I ______ hello.
explanation: 第三條件句的主句是 would have + 過去分詞，表示過去本來會做、卻沒做。
example: If she had known, she would have told us.

label: If + 現在式, will
prompt: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
explanation: 第一條件句談未來可能發生的事：If + 現在式，主句 will + 原形。if 子句裡不用 will。
example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

label: unless = if not
prompt: You will be late ______ you leave now.
explanation: unless 表示「除非」，意思接近 if not。除非你現在出發，否則會遲到。
example: Unless we act now, the problem will get worse.

label: No sooner had...
prompt: No sooner ______ down than the doorbell rang.
explanation: No sooner 放在句首要倒裝：No sooner + had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + than...。
example: No sooner had the film started than the baby began to cry.

label: Never have I...
prompt: Never ______ such a beautiful city.
explanation: 否定副詞 Never 放在句首時，助動詞要放在主詞前面：Never have I seen...。
example: Never have I heard such a clear explanation.

label: Not only did...
prompt: Not only ______ the exam, but she also won a prize.
explanation: Not only 放在句首時，前半句要倒裝。一般動詞用 did + 主詞 + 原形。
example: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot his notes.

label: Seldom have I...
prompt: Seldom ______ so nervous before an exam.
explanation: Seldom（很少）放在句首要倒裝：Seldom have I felt...。
example: Seldom do we get such a clear result.

label: Under no circumstances
prompt: Under no circumstances ______ the laboratory unattended.
explanation: Under no circumstances（在任何情況下都不）放在句首時要倒裝，把助動詞放在主詞前。
example: Under no circumstances should you share your password.

label: Little did I know
prompt: Little ______ how hard the course would be.
explanation: Little 放在句首、表示「完全不」時要倒裝：Little did I know...。
example: Little did she realise that the bus had already left.

label: a number of + 複數動詞
prompt: A number of students ______ absent yesterday.
explanation: a number of 表示「許多」，後面的動詞用複數。the number of 才用單數動詞。
example: A number of residents were unhappy about the noise.

label: the majority of
prompt: The majority of the students ______ in favour of the change.
explanation: the majority of 後面若是複數名詞，動詞通常用複數。
example: The majority of voters are still undecided.

label: each of + 單數動詞
prompt: Each of the answers ______ correct.
explanation: Each of + 複數名詞時，真正的主詞是 each，動詞用單數。
example: Each of the students has a locker.

label: news 用單數
prompt: The news ______ surprising to everyone.
explanation: news 看起來像複數，其實是不可數名詞，動詞用單數。
example: The news about the election was announced this morning.

label: people 用複數
prompt: People in this town ______ very friendly.
explanation: people 表示「人們」時是複數，動詞用 are 或 were。
example: People who live here are proud of their hometown.

label: neither of
prompt: Neither of the options ______ suitable.
explanation: Neither of 表示「兩者都不」，正式用法動詞用單數。
example: Neither of the reports is complete.

label: There is + 單數
prompt: There ______ a serious problem with the data.
explanation: There 後面若是單數名詞，動詞用 is。problem 是單數，所以用 There is。
example: There is a bank near the station.

label: was / were + 過去分詞
prompt: The bridge ______ in 1998.
explanation: 被動語態是 be + 過去分詞。1998 是過去的時間，所以用 was built。
example: The museum was opened by the mayor.

label: is / are + 過去分詞
prompt: English ______ in many countries.
explanation: 現在簡單式的被動是 is 或 are + 過去分詞。語言「被說」用 is spoken。
example: Recycling is collected every Tuesday.

label: has been + 過去分詞
prompt: The report ______ yet.
explanation: 現在完成被動是 has 或 have been + 過去分詞。yet 常配完成式。
example: The road has been closed for repairs.

label: must be + 過去分詞
prompt: The form ______ in black ink.
explanation: 情態動詞的被動是 must、should 或 can + be + 過去分詞。
example: Seat belts must be worn in the car.

label: who 指人
prompt: The teacher ______ taught me English has retired.
explanation: 關係子句裡，人當主詞時用 who 或 that。who 代替 teacher，後面直接接動詞 taught。
example: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.

label: which 指事物
prompt: The laptop ______ I bought last year is already slow.
explanation: 事物用 which 或 that。這裡 which 代替 laptop，是 bought 的受詞。
example: The book which you lent me was excellent.

label: whose 表示誰的
prompt: I have a friend ______ brother studies in London.
explanation: whose 表示「誰的」，後面要接名詞。whose brother 就是「他的哥哥」。
example: She is the author whose novel won the prize.

label: where 指地方
prompt: This is the cafe ______ we first met.
explanation: 地方後面常用 where，意思接近 in which。cafe 是地方，所以用 where。
example: The town where I grew up is by the sea.

label: 非限定關係子句
prompt: Taipei, ______ is the capital, is very busy.
explanation: 逗號隔開的非限定關係子句用來補充說明。事物用 which，而且不能省略。
example: My brother, who lives in Taipei, is a nurse.

label: since + 現在完成式
prompt: I ______ in this city since 2019.
explanation: since + 過去的時間點，用現在完成式 have 或 has + 過去分詞，表示從那時一直到現在。
example: She has worked here since March.

label: ago 用過去式
prompt: I ______ this film two years ago.
explanation: ago 是已經結束的過去時間，用過去簡單式，不用現在完成式。
example: They moved house five years ago.

label: for + 一段時間
prompt: She ______ English for six years.
explanation: for + 一段時間，而且這件事持續到現在，用現在完成式。
example: We have known each other for ten years.

label: have just + 過去分詞
prompt: He ______ just finished his homework.
explanation: just 常與現在完成式連用：have 或 has just + 過去分詞，表示剛剛做完。
example: I have just submitted the essay.

label: has been + V-ing
prompt: It ______ all morning, so the ground is wet.
explanation: 從過去一直持續到現在、並強調這段過程，用 have 或 has been + V-ing。
example: She has been waiting for an hour.

label: had + 過去分詞
prompt: When I arrived, the lesson ______.
explanation: 「過去的過去」用 had + 過去分詞。課程在我到達之前就已經開始了。
example: She had left before I called.

label: by the time + had
prompt: By the time we got to the station, the train ______.
explanation: by the time 接過去式時，更早完成的動作用 had + 過去分詞。
example: By the time he was thirty, he had started his own shop.

label: more + 多音節形容詞
prompt: This question is ______ than the last one.
explanation: 多音節形容詞的比較級用 more + 原級，不加 -er。
example: Living in the city is more expensive than living in a town.

label: the most
prompt: It is ______ city I have ever visited.
explanation: 最高級是 the + most + 多音節形容詞。the most beautiful city 後面常接 I have ever...。
example: This is the most interesting book I have read this year.

label: as + 原級 + as
prompt: The exam was not ______ I expected.
explanation: 同等比較用 as + 形容詞原級 + as。否定可以說 not as ... as。
example: The hotel was not as clean as the photos suggested.

label: the more..., the more...
prompt: ______ you practise, the more confident you become.
explanation: the + 比較級, the + 比較級，表示「越…就越…」。
example: The earlier we start, the sooner we will finish.

label: fewer 與 less
prompt: There were ______ people than yesterday.
explanation: fewer 修飾可數複數名詞；less 修飾不可數名詞。people 可數，所以用 fewer。
example: We should eat less sugar and fewer snacks.

label: Having + 過去分詞
prompt: ______ the instructions carefully, he started the experiment.
explanation: Having + 過去分詞表示這個動作先做完，再做主要動作。主詞與後面的句子相同，所以不再寫 he。
example: Having finished the report, she went home.

label: 過去分詞開頭
prompt: ______ in 1920, the building is now a museum.
explanation: 過去分詞放在句首表示被動。the building was built，所以用 Built in 1920。
example: Located near the river, the cafe is very popular.

label: Not + V-ing
prompt: Not ______ the address, we got lost.
explanation: Not + V-ing 可以表示原因。主詞是 we，而且是主動「不知道」，所以用 knowing。
example: Feeling tired, I went to bed early.

label: It is important that
prompt: It is important ______ students get enough sleep.
explanation: It is important that + 完整句子。that 引導名詞子句，是句子真正的主詞。
example: It is clear that the policy has failed.

label: whether
prompt: I do not know ______ she will come.
explanation: 不確定「是或不是」時，用 whether 或 if 引導名詞子句。whether 可以加 or not。
example: We need to decide whether to accept the offer.

label: What 當主詞
prompt: ______ surprised me was the price.
explanation: What 可以引導名詞子句，表示「所…的事物」，並當作句子的主詞。
example: What we need is more time.

label: must have + 過去分詞
prompt: The lights are off. They ______ home.
explanation: 對過去的事情很有把握的推測，用 must have + 過去分詞。
example: She must have forgotten, because she did not call.

label: can't have + 過去分詞
prompt: He ______ the email, because he was on a plane.
explanation: 對過去的否定推測用 can't 或 couldn't have + 過去分詞，表示「不可能做過」。
example: She can't have been at home, because nobody answered.

label: might have + 過去分詞
prompt: I ______ my keys at the office.
explanation: 對過去不確定的推測用 might have + 過去分詞。
example: They might have missed the bus.

label: should have + 過去分詞
prompt: You ______ earlier. The shop is closed now.
explanation: should have + 過去分詞表示過去該做、卻沒有做。
example: I should have revised more before the test.

label: enjoy + V-ing
prompt: She enjoys ______ in the evening.
explanation: enjoy 後面接動名詞 V-ing，不接 to + 原形。
example: I avoid eating late at night.

label: decide to
prompt: They decided ______ the trip.
explanation: decide、agree、hope、plan 這類動詞後面接 to + 原形。
example: He agreed to help us.

label: stop to V
prompt: He stopped ______ a coffee on the way home.（停下來去做另一件事）
explanation: stop to V 表示停下來，以便去做另一件事。stop V-ing 才是停止正在做的事。
example: She stopped to ask for directions.

label: suggest + V-ing
prompt: The doctor suggested ______ more exercise.
explanation: suggest 後面接 V-ing，或 suggest that + 子句，不接 to V。
example: She recommended joining a study group.

label: used to + 原形
prompt: I ______ live in Taichung when I was a child.
explanation: used to + 原形表示過去的習慣，而且現在已經不是這樣。
example: People used to write letters instead of emails.

label: be used to + V-ing
prompt: I am used to ______ early.
explanation: be used to 表示「習慣於」。這裡的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing 或名詞。
example: She is used to working at night.

label: get used to + V-ing
prompt: It took me a month to get used to ______ in a big city.
explanation: get used to 表示「逐漸習慣」，to 同樣是介系詞，後面接 V-ing 或名詞。
example: You will get used to the accent.

label: although + 子句
prompt: ______ it was raining, we went out.
explanation: although 後面接有主詞和動詞的子句。despite 後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接完整子句。
example: Although the course was hard, she enjoyed it.

label: despite + 名詞
prompt: ______ the rain, we went out.
explanation: despite 後面接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing，不接完整子句。
example: Despite feeling nervous, he gave a clear speech.

label: because of + 名詞
prompt: The match was cancelled ______ the storm.
explanation: because of 後面接名詞。because 後面要接完整子句。storm 是名詞，所以用 because of。
example: She was late because of the traffic.

label: so that
prompt: He spoke slowly ______ everyone could understand.
explanation: so that + 完整子句，表示目的，意思是「為了讓…」。
example: She set an alarm so that she would not oversleep.

label: so + 形容詞 + that
prompt: The film was ______ boring that we left early.
explanation: so + 形容詞或副詞 + that。such 則配名詞：such a boring film。
example: The bag was so heavy that I could not lift it.

label: such a + 名詞
prompt: It was ______ a difficult question that nobody answered.
explanation: such a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that。so 直接接形容詞，不接 a + 名詞。
example: It was such a hot day that we stayed indoors.

label: wish + 過去式
prompt: I wish I ______ more free time.
explanation: wish 後面用過去式，表示現在無法實現的願望。I wish I had 表示我現在並沒有。
example: I wish I knew the answer.

label: wish + had + 過去分詞
prompt: I wish I ______ harder for the exam.
explanation: 後悔過去的事，wish 後面用 had + 過去分詞。
example: She wishes she had taken the earlier train.

label: said that + 過去式
prompt: She said that she ______ tired.
explanation: 轉述過去說的話時，現在式常改成過去式。I am tired 會變成 she said she was tired。
example: He told me that he had finished the work.

label: the day before
prompt: He told me that he ______ the day before.
explanation: 轉述過去更早發生的事，用 had + 過去分詞。the day before 表示「那天的前一天」，搭配過去完成式。
example: She said she had seen the film the week before.

label: will 改成 would
prompt: He said he ______ me the next day.
explanation: 直接引句的 will，在過去式的轉述裡改成 would。
example: They said they would send the results soon.

label: be going to
prompt: Look at those clouds. It ______.
explanation: 眼前已有證據的預測用 be going to。看到烏雲，所以判斷快下雨了。
example: She is going to start a new course in June.

label: 現在進行式表未來
prompt: I ______ a friend at six o'clock tonight.
explanation: 已經約好的未來行程，常用現在進行式。
example: We are flying to Tokyo tomorrow morning.

label: 獨一無二用 the
prompt: ______ Sun rises in the east.
explanation: 世上獨一無二的事物用 the，例如 the Sun、the Earth。
example: The Moon looks bright tonight.

label: an + 母音音
prompt: She is ______ honest person.
explanation: honest 的 h 不發音，開頭是母音，所以用 an，不是 a。
example: It takes an hour to get there.

label: go to school
prompt: My brother goes to ______ every day.
explanation: go to school、go to work、go to bed 表示去做這件事時，不加 the。
example: She goes to work at eight.

label: information 不可數
prompt: Could you give me ______ information?
explanation: information 是不可數名詞，不能加 a 或 an，也不能用 many。可以說 some information 或 a piece of information。
example: The teacher gave us some useful advice.

label: a piece of advice
prompt: She gave me a good ______.
explanation: advice 不可數，不能說 an advice 或 advices。要說 a piece of advice。advise 是動詞。
example: Let me give you a piece of advice.

label: much + 不可數
prompt: How ______ money do you need?
explanation: money、time、water 這類不可數名詞用 much。可數複數才用 many。
example: There is not much time left.

label: few 與 a few
prompt: I have ______ friends in this city, so I feel lonely.（幾乎沒有）
explanation: few 表示「幾乎沒有」，語氣偏否定；a few 表示「有一些」。friends 可數，所以用 few，不用 little。
example: Few people understood the lecture.

label: little + 不可數
prompt: There is ______ milk left. We need to buy more.
explanation: little 修飾不可數名詞，表示「幾乎沒有」。a little 才是「有一點」。
example: Little progress has been made.

label: However
prompt: The hotel was expensive. ______, the location was perfect.
explanation: However 是副詞，用來連接兩個句子，後面通常加逗號。Although 必須接子句，不能單獨放在句首當轉折。
example: The task was hard. However, we finished it on time.

label: in spite of
prompt: ______ being tired, she kept working.
explanation: in spite of 和 despite 一樣，後面接名詞或 V-ing。英文沒有 despite of 這個說法。
example: In spite of the delay, we arrived before noon.

label: 並列形式要一致
prompt: She likes swimming, reading and ______.
explanation: 並列的詞形式要一致。swimming 和 reading 都是 V-ing，所以第三個也用 cooking。
example: The job involves planning, writing and presenting.

label: not only... but also
prompt: The course is not only interesting ______ useful.
explanation: not only ... but also ... 是固定搭配，兩邊的詞性要對稱。
example: He is not only a teacher but also a writer.

label: prefer A to B
prompt: I prefer tea ______ coffee.
explanation: 比較兩個名詞時用 prefer A to B，不用 prefer A than B。
example: She prefers walking to driving.

label: look forward to + V-ing
prompt: I look forward to ______ from you.
explanation: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing，不是原形動詞。
example: We look forward to seeing you next week.

label: make + 受詞 + 形容詞
prompt: The news made her ______.
explanation: make + 受詞 + 形容詞，形容受詞的狀態。副詞 happily 不能放在這個位置。
example: Loud music makes it hard to concentrate.

label: let + 原形
prompt: My parents let me ______ out late at weekends.
explanation: let、make 後面接原形動詞：let somebody do something，不加 to。
example: The teacher let us leave early.

label: increase by
prompt: Sales increased ______ 20% last year.
explanation: 增加的幅度用 by。增加到某個數字才用 to，例如 increased to 20%。
example: The price rose by five pounds.

label: Compared with
prompt: ______ with 2010, the population is much larger.
explanation: Compared with 或 compared to 是固定分詞片語，表示「與…相比」。
example: Compared with buses, trains are more comfortable.

label: between A and B
prompt: The difference ______ the two groups is small.
explanation: 兩者之間用 between。among 用於三者或更多。
example: The shop is between the bank and the post office.

label: depend on
prompt: The result depends ______ how often you practise.
explanation: depend 後面的介系詞是 on，不是 of。depend on 表示「取決於」。
example: Success depends on regular practice.

label: interested in
prompt: She is interested ______ history.
explanation: interested 後面用 in。good at、keen on 則是別的搭配。
example: He is interested in how cities are planned.

label: good at
prompt: He is good ______ explaining difficult ideas.
explanation: good、bad、skilled 後面常用 at + 名詞或 V-ing。
example: She is good at listening to other people.
